title: Frappe ERPNext 10.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 10.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated attackers, including portal users or users without assigned roles, to access Payment Terms Template data by sending crafted requests for records outside their permission scope.
